default.notes: Apply online via the official ANRPTS e-visa portal before travel; the fee (about EUR 55 for 30 days) is paid in cash in euros or US dollars on arrival.

groups.notes: Visa-exempt under bilateral and regional agreements — stays of up to 90 days.

MR.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Mauritanian citizens.

IL.notes: Mauritania severed relations with Israel in 2010 and Israeli passports are not accepted for entry.

SY.notes: e-Visa required, and Syrian nationals have historically needed additional security clearance — confirm with a Mauritanian embassy before booking.
